verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of a view of New Relic's own observability spend or ingest usage, no attribution of that spend to teams or services, and no usage-spike or budget alerting. The closest items do not count toward this story: the 100 GB free-ingest tier is a pricing fact, 'multi-cloud and Kubernetes spend' is about infrastructure cost rather than observability spend, generic NRQL alerts are a building block, and a community-mentioned Data Management Hub log toggle is an adjacent control. Community reports of surprise ingest increases only highlight the gap.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can see what my observability spend is, attribute it to teams or services, and catch usage spikes before the bill
